decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the firm's core map.apps platform, and its rapid release cadence shows the firm can interpret user feedback and keep improving it.

The hierarchical search bundle is a small, low-cost plugin that fits squarely within existing web-map expertise, though its modest website presence suggests it may be folded into other search functionality.

The mobile layer control builds on established map control knowledge and responds to a clear usability need, but as a component on a newer framework it is somewhat more likely to be superseded or merged.
The GIS solution platform is the backbone of the firm's reusable architecture and accumulated knowledge, so dropping it would undermine its established business.
Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's GIS integration competence and serves recurring needs of public and utility customers, and its dedicated page signals commitment.
The search extension is closely tied to existing web-map apps and has its own page, so the firm can readily maintain and refine it with its in-house development capacity.
